## Design

### 2026-10-09 – #### October 9: Making progress on the Driver Deck PCB!!

**1.5h**

#### October 9: Making progress on the Driver Deck PCB!!

I started designing the PCB for my FRC 5719 Driver Deck using KiCad! The goal is to make a custom keyboard controller with WASD keys, four programmable buttons, an OLED screen, and RGB LEDs around the edge.

So far, I’ve worked on connecting the XIAO RP2040, the switches and diodes, and the OLED display. I also started wiring the RGB LEDs, including the level shifter and capacitor needed to help them work reliably.

There’s still work to do on the PCB layout and checking the connections, but the schematic is starting to come together!
I split my work session into 3 half hour sessions.
Session 1: Getting some footprints, and putting them down.
Session 2: Wiring.
Session 3: ERC Checking.

### 2026-10-10 – #### October 10: ERC DEBUGGING! GAHHHH

**2h**

#### October 10: ERC DEBUGGING! GAHHHH

So today I decided to actually read what the ERC said and let me tell you it is not fun at all. 40 ERRORS when i started half an hour in and I am at 43 I DONT EVEN KNOW HOW. Anyways i fixed some stuff by adding power flags and used the highlight tool and all my traces were fine but still had errors. So I clicked around and then asked big GPT for help which didn't work so then I moved on to selecting  my footprints and hopefully drawing my PCB traces wont be too much of a hassle with all those ERC errors.
